charts.title: Gliese 12 b: orbits around Gliese 12
charts.description: The orbits of Gliese 12's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Gliese 12 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Turner et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.545f1703T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname TURNER_ET_AL_2026): P 12.761418 d

charts.title: Gliese 12 b: its transit
charts.description: Gliese 12 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (57, 70, 84) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 52005579, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
